shortDescription: Module for setup of ServerAutoScalePolicy Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: delay_for_server_garbage_collection
options.description: Delay in minutes after which a down server will be removed from pool. Value 0 disables this functionality. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: intelligent_autoscale
options.description: Use avi intelligent autoscale algorithm where autoscale is performed by comparing load on the pool against estimated capacity of all the servers. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: intelligent_scalein_margin
options.description: Maximum extra capacity as percentage of load used by the intelligent scheme. Scale-in is triggered when available capacity is more than this margin. Allowed values are 1-99. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 40.

options.name: intelligent_scaleout_margin
options.description: Minimum extra capacity as percentage of load used by the intelligent scheme. Scale-out is triggered when available capacity is less than this margin. Allowed values are 1-99. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: max_scalein_adjustment_step
options.description: Maximum number of servers to scale-in simultaneously. The actual number of servers to scale-in is chosen such that target number of servers is always more than or equal to the min_size. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: max_scaleout_adjustment_step
options.description: Maximum number of servers to scale-out simultaneously. The actual number of servers to scale-out is chosen such that target number of servers is always less than or equal to the max_size. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: max_size
options.description: Maximum number of servers after scale-out. Allowed values are 0-400. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: min_size
options.description: No scale-in happens once number of operationally up servers reach min_servers. Allowed values are 0-400. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: scalein_alertconfig_refs
options.description: Trigger scale-in when alerts due to any of these alert configurations are raised. It is a reference to an object of type alertconfig. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: scalein_cooldown
options.description: Cooldown period during which no new scale-in is triggered to allow previous scale-in to successfully complete. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: scaleout_alertconfig_refs
options.description: Trigger scale-out when alerts due to any of these alert configurations are raised. It is a reference to an object of type alertconfig. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: scaleout_cooldown
options.description: Cooldown period during which no new scale-out is triggered to allow previous scale-out to successfully complete. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: scheduled_scalings
options.description: Scheduled-based scale-in/out policy. During scheduled intervals, metrics based autoscale is not enabled and number of servers will be solely derived from schedulescale policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Maximum of 1 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: use_predicted_load
options.description: Use predicted load rather than current load. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
